verdict.rationale: Cake documents an MCP server that lets developers connect AI clients and query stakeholders, share classes, vesting, SAFEs and notes from the live cap table, which is a documented programmatic access channel, but it is explicitly read-only and Q&A-style rather than a structured API returning the full cap table dataset; a probe found no OpenAPI/REST API endpoints. Missing for 10: a documented REST/GraphQL API with structured endpoints for stakeholders/share classes/securities/vesting states, evidence of bulk/full data retrieval beyond conversational queries, and independent confirmation of API completeness.
